Supported platforms are sqlserver (SQL Server using sqlcmd.exe) and postres (PostgreSQL using psql.exe).
If you don't need one, you may remove it or simply leave its 'servers' object empty.

sqlserver: delimiter (optional) - the separator between columns in returned query results. Default: | (pipe)
alignLimit (optional) - the maximum allowable time in seconds to be spent aligning columns. Default: 5
servers - an object containing server objects

servers: Keys are server names in sqlcmd's -S or psql's -h parameter (IP address, hostname, or named instance.)

HOSTNAME: order (optional) - an integer to move favorite servers to the top of the catalog in ascending order.
marks (optional) - an object containing letters and their corresponding database names, used to quickly
navigate to a database in the Catalog using the nvim jump-to-mark commands. See :h 'a
args (optional) - additional command line arguments. For example, SQL Server user ID and password are entered
with '-U':'user' and '-P':'password'. For a switch with no value, use null like so: '-j':null
